newsitem.title: GERMANY: IBM, German media group form Internet partnership.
newsitem.headline: IBM, German media group form Internet partnership.

text.p: Computer giant IBM Corp. said on Monday its German unit had formed a partnership with broadcaster Suedwestfunk to develop Internet-related ventures.

The two planned to develop a virtual shopping mall on the Internet where computer users would be able to purchase IBM products and items related to Suedwestfunk programming, the company said in a statement.
They will also work together on educational products for the Internet and converting 50 years of archived radio programmes into digital format that can be stored and retrieved by computer, IBM said.
IBM Deutschland GmbH and Suedwestfunk recently opened an "Internet cafe" in Mainz where customers can surf the worldwide computer network.
